_doc: Hand-authored pins for wawa-hero (disco/funk, Suno). The tempo wanders 123-126 BPM (mean 124.7) section by section, so the chart follows the tracked beat grid. Callout times: whisper medium + MMS forced alignment located the words; the exact times are vocal attacks (300-3000 Hz onsets on the demucs vocal stem). Notes stay on the beat grid unless the singer is > 30 ms off it ('snap': false). Chorus 2 = chorus 1 + 160 beats; its vocal drops the callouts after 'Left up!' - the same dance routine is kept there. '(Clap clap!)' is not audible in either chorus.
